decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): The cited excerpt [ev-188e63ccea10] is just a table-of-contents link. However, the matching upgrade-guide step [ev-06a16cdbc869] describes the change concretely. Subject: the ManagedResourceActivationPolicy (MRAP). Change: Crossplane v2 automatically creates a default MRAP that activates all managed resources (`*`). Who is exposed and what happens: anyone upgrading to v2 gets all managed resources activated if they do nothing, and replacing the default with a targeted MRAP before installing v2 providers is an optional step for cluster resource efficiency. [ev-dd988a5ed5c3] adds that existing cluster-scoped managed resources keep working unchanged, which is enough to write the typed assertion.
